newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN OCTOBER TRACTOR SALES UP 41 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN OCTOBER TRACTOR SALES UP 41 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: South African farmers continued to snap up new tractors in October with sales reaching 666 units, up 41.4 percent on the same month last year, the South African Agricultural Machinery Association said.
On a year-to-date basis sales were 40.8 percent up on last year at 5,062.
The association said sales were likely to reach 6,000 this year, but it was cautious about prospects for 1997.

"The continued weakening of the rand is placing extreme pressure on tractor prices. In addition, with the prospects for the North American maize crop currently looking good, this will adversely affect local maize prices in the forthcoming season," it said.
